================================================================================
Bare namespace-macro sentinels before preproc blocks
================================================================================

NS_BEGIN
namespace d {
int x;
}
NS_END

#if defined(X)
    #undef X
#endif
#define X 1
int z;

---

(translation_unit
  (macro_declaration
    (identifier))
  (namespace_definition
    name: (namespace_identifier)
    body: (declaration_list
      (declaration
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (identifier))))
  (macro_declaration
    (identifier))
  (preproc_if
    condition: (preproc_defined
      (identifier))
    (preproc_call
      directive: (preproc_directive)
      argument: (preproc_arg)))
  (preproc_def
    name: (identifier)
    value: (preproc_arg))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (identifier)))

================================================================================
Namespace BEGIN/END macro pairs wrap their contents
================================================================================

NLOHMANN_JSON_NAMESPACE_BEGIN
namespace detail {
int x;
}
NLOHMANN_JSON_NAMESPACE_END
int z;

---

(translation_unit
  (macro_namespace
    (namespace_definition
      name: (namespace_identifier)
      body: (declaration_list
        (declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier)))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (identifier)))

================================================================================
Function signature split across #if/#else
================================================================================

#if COND
    inline bool operator<(int lhs, int rhs) noexcept
#else
    inline bool operator==(int lhs, int rhs) noexcept
#endif
{
    return true;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (guarded_function
    (preproc_if_in_guarded_signature
      condition: (identifier)
      (storage_class_specifier)
      type: (primitive_type)
      (function_declarator
        declarator: (operator_name)
        parameters: (parameter_list
          (parameter_declaration
            type: (primitive_type)
            declarator: (identifier))
          (parameter_declaration
            type: (primitive_type)
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (noexcept))
      alternative: (preproc_else
        (storage_class_specifier)
        type: (primitive_type)
        (function_declarator
          declarator: (operator_name)
          parameters: (parameter_list
            (parameter_declaration
              type: (primitive_type)
              declarator: (identifier))
            (parameter_declaration
              type: (primitive_type)
              declarator: (identifier)))
          (noexcept))))
    (compound_statement
      (return_statement
        (true)))))
